title: 无不 V (there is nothing that doesn’t V)
shortExplanation: there is nothing that doesn’t V
longExplanation: there is nothing that doesn’t V. Pinyin: wúbù V

examples.sentence: 你的一言一行，一举一动，无不影响着你周围的人们。
examples.romanization: nǐ de yīyányīxíng， yījǔyīdòng， wúbù yǐngxiǎng zhe nǐ zhōuwéi de rénmen。
examples.translation: Your words and deeds, every move, they all (lit. there is nothing that doesn’t) affect the people around you.

title: 换句话说/(也)就是说 (in other words)
longExplanation: in other words. Pinyin: huànjùhuàshuō/( yě) jiùshìshuō

examples.sentence: 每个国家都应与他国和睦相处。换句话说/(也)就是说，国家不能为所欲为。
examples.romanization: měi gè guójiā dōu yīng yǔ tāguó hémùxiāngchǔ。 huànjùhuàshuō/( yě) jiùshìshuō， guójiā bùnéng wéisuǒyùwéi。
examples.translation: Every country should live in harmony with other countries. In other words, a country can't do whatever it wants.

title: 为 S 所 V (V’ed by S)
longExplanation: V’ed by S. Pinyin: wéi S suǒ V

examples.sentence: 没有一个人不为这部电影中的人物所感动。
examples.romanization: méiyǒu yīgèrén bù wéi zhè bù diànyǐng zhòngdì rénwù suǒ gǎndòng。
examples.translation: No one is [left] untouched by the characters in this movie.

examples.sentence: 对这样的坏人不严惩就不足以平民愤。
examples.romanization: duì zhèyàng de huàirén bù yánchéng jiù bùzú yǐ píngmín fèn。
examples.translation: If they do not severely punish such bad people, it won’t be enough to calm the anger civilians.

title: 东 # M 西 # M (one here and one there, willy nilly)
shortExplanation: one here and one there, willy nilly
longExplanation: one here and one there, willy nilly. Pinyin: dōng # M xī # M

examples.sentence: 客人还不走，我只好跟他东一句西一句地没话找话说。
examples.romanization: kèrén hái bù zǒu， wǒ zhǐhǎo gēn tā dōng yījù xī yījù dì méi huà zhǎo huàshuō。
examples.translation: The guest is not leaving yet, so I have to talk aimlessly to him.

title: V 中 (zhòng) (V on the mark)
longExplanation: V on the mark. Pinyin: V zhōng (zhòng)

examples.sentence: 飞来一只苍蝇，人动手去打，却总是打不中。
examples.romanization: fēi lái yī zhǐ cāngying， rén dòngshǒu qù dǎ， què zǒngshì dǎ bù zhōng。
examples.translation: A fly flew in. People tried to hit it with their hands but always missed it.

title: 中 (zhòng) N (hit by N)
longExplanation: hit by N. Pinyin: zhōng (zhòng) N

examples.sentence: 这种蘑菇不能吃，吃了会中毒的。
examples.romanization: zhèzhǒng mógu bùnéng chī， chī le huì zhòngdú de。
examples.translation: This kind of mushroom can't be eaten. You will be poisoned if you eat it.

examples.sentence: 这件事，你姑且先答应下来，然后再慢慢想办法。
examples.romanization: zhè jiàn shì， nǐ gūqiě xiān dāying xiàlai， ránhòu zài mànmàn xiǎng bànfǎ。
examples.translation: As for this matter, you can agree to it for now, and then take your time and think about how to deal with it.

examples.sentence: 耶稣受了洗，随即从水里上来。
examples.romanization: Yēsū shòu le xǐ， suíjí cóng Shuǐlǐ shànglái。
examples.translation: As soon as Jesus was baptized, he went up out of the water.

examples.sentence: 咱们宁愿多花点儿钱，也要买个质量好的。
examples.romanization: zánmen nìngyuàn duō huā diǎnr qián， yě yào mǎi gè zhìliàng hǎo de。
examples.translation: We'd rather spend more money than buy a good one.

title: N 归 N (although N is N)
longExplanation: although N is N. Pinyin: N guī N

examples.sentence: 朋友之间，开玩笑归开玩笑，但千万别过了头。
examples.romanization: péngyou zhījiān， kāiwánxiào guī kāiwánxiào， dàn qiānwàn bié guò le tóu。
examples.translation: Between friends, [although] jokes are jokes, but don't go too far.

examples.sentence: 人是在实践中接受环境的影响，进而改造自己的。
examples.romanization: rén shì zài shíjiàn zhōng jiēshòu huánjìng de yǐngxiǎng， jìn'ér gǎizào zìjǐ de。
examples.translation: It is through trial and error, mankind is influenced by their environment, and then transform themselves.

title: 得以 V (be enabled to V)
longExplanation: be enabled to V. Pinyin: déyǐ V

examples.sentence: 他因为年轻，得以免除惩罚。
examples.romanization: tā yīnwèi niánqīng， déyǐ miǎnchú chéngfá。
examples.translation: He is young, [which] enabled [him] to be exempt from punishment.

title: 偏偏 V (just V, to insist on V)
shortExplanation: just V, to insist on V
longExplanation: just V, to insist on V. Pinyin: piānpiān V

examples.sentence: 那里太危险了，大家都劝他不要去，他偏偏要去。
examples.romanization: nàli tài wēixiǎn le， dàjiā dōu quàn tā bùyào qù， tā piānpiān yào qù。
examples.translation: It's too dangerous there. Everyone advised him not to go. He just wanted to go. (He insisted on going.)

title: 偏偏 CLAUSE ((CLAUSE is an undesirable occurence by chance))
shortExplanation: (CLAUSE is an undesirable occurence by chance)
longExplanation: (CLAUSE is an undesirable occurence by chance). Pinyin: piānpiān CLAUSE

examples.sentence: 正当我坐下来吃晚饭时, 偏偏电话来了。
examples.romanization: zhèngdàng wǒ zuò xiàlai chī wǎnfàn shí,  piānpiān diànhuà lái le。
examples.translation: It just have to [be] when I sit down and eat supper that a call came.
